title: Attack surface reduction rules are left in audit or warn

settledDays.text: Days after which audit or warn has stopped being a trial

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy has', 'policies have')} attack surface reduction rules that only audit or warn

messages.businessImpact: Rules in audit record what they would have blocked and block nothing, and rules in warn let anyone who clicks past the prompt carry on. Either left in place is a control that exists on paper only.
remediation: Review the audit events for the rules listed, add exclusions for genuine business software, then set them to block.
messages.cannotSee: Only attack surface reduction policies are read, so a rule left in audit or warn by a Settings Catalog profile or a security baseline is not reported. The policy's last change stands in for when the rule was put in audit or warn, so a policy edited for any other reason starts the count again.
